The base class `Node` and the nodes that draw shapes, text, images, media, progress bars, charts and 3D models, with their tooltips and their drag settings.
Learn: [Nodes and the tree](/use/learn/describing-the-ui/nodes/), [Position and size](/use/learn/describing-the-ui/position-and-size/), [Images and media](/use/learn/describing-the-ui/media/).

[`BaseModelNode`](/reference/nodes/basemodelnode/), [`ChartNode`](/reference/nodes/chartnode/) and [`RadarChartNode`](/reference/nodes/radarchartnode/) need a skin, a subclass that draws the node: see [Give your controls a look](/use/learn/going-further/ui-kit/).

## Main types

| Type | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`Node`](/reference/nodes/node/) | class | Base class of every element of a UI, a box in design pixels with children, fluent properties, input, hover, scroll, drag and effects. |
| [`BaseModelNode`](/reference/nodes/basemodelnode/) | class | Base class of the nodes that draw a 3D model in their bounds. |
| [`ChartNode`](/reference/nodes/chartnode/) | class | Base class of a chart that shows named series of values over the labels of an X axis. |
| [`CircleNode`](/reference/nodes/circlenode/) | class | Draws a filled disc in its bounds, with a color that fades on hover. |
| [`DevNode`](/reference/nodes/devnode/) | class | The dev panel of a UI in dev mode, with the inspector, the reload button, the grid and the frame rate. |
| [`ModelNode`](/reference/nodes/modelnode/) | class | Draws a 3D model at a zoom and a rotation that your code sets. |
| [`ModelViewerNode`](/reference/nodes/modelviewernode/) | class | Draws a 3D model that the user turns by dragging and zooms with the wheel, within ranges. |
| [`ProgressNode`](/reference/nodes/progressnode/) | class | Shows a progress from 0 to 1 by sizing its fill part over an optional track part. |
| [`RadarChartNode`](/reference/nodes/radarchartnode/) | class | Base class of a radar chart, which shows one value per axis around a center. |
| [`RectNode`](/reference/nodes/rectnode/) | class | Draws a filled rectangle on its bounds, with an optional border, and colors that fade on hover. |
| [`ResourceNode`](/reference/nodes/resourcenode/) | class | Draws an image resource in its bounds, tinted by a color, with an optional image that fades in on hover. |
| [`ResourcePlayerNode`](/reference/nodes/resourceplayernode/) | class | Plays a video or an animated image in its bounds, with its sound, and controls the playback. |
| [`TextNode`](/reference/nodes/textnode/) | class | Draws a `Text` in its bounds, and takes the size of the text when no size is declared. |

## Related types

The interfaces, enums and helper classes of this family that the main types use.

| Type | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`CustomHoverElement`](/reference/nodes/customhoverelement/) | class | Places a tooltip element of your own at the mouse, on the node or at a fixed point. |
| [`DraggableProperty`](/reference/nodes/draggableproperty/) | class | How a node is dragged: the area it stays in, whether it moves or leaves a copy, and the targets it snaps to. |
| [`HoverSupplier`](/reference/nodes/hoversupplier/) | interface | Function that gives the single line of a text tooltip. |
| [`IHoverElement`](/reference/nodes/ihoverelement/) | interface | A tooltip element that draws itself while its node is hovered. |
| [`INode`](/reference/nodes/inode/) | interface | The hooks that JOID calls on a node, all empty by default, that a node of your own overrides. |
| [`NodeHoverElement`](/reference/nodes/nodehoverelement/) | class | Tooltip made of a node, loaded and drawn while its owner is hovered. |
| [`NodeLayer`](/reference/nodes/nodelayer/) | interface | Function that draws over a node, after its children, in the coordinates of the node. |
| [`PositionedHoverElement`](/reference/nodes/positionedhoverelement/) | class | Tooltip element placed at the mouse, on the node or at a fixed point, and kept inside the window. |
